name: chrome
description: Google Chrome on bia's own profile with remote debugging: chrome_install / start / restart / stop / status run it; page tools come from chrome-devtools-mcp (chrome_take_snapshot first, then click or fill by uid). Tabs opening and closing arrive as system|chrome lines, and so does a file dialog opening (an upload button or drop zone was clicked): answer it with chrome_choose_files(paths=[...]) or cancel=true (for a folder it also confirms Chrome's "Upload N files to this site?"). Downloads land in /home/bia/Downloads without asking, several at once too. For clicks outside the page (some captchas) use mcp/screen. Messages on Facebook, Instagram, Telegram and WhatsApp go through mcp/messenger, mcp/instagram, mcp/telegram and mcp/whatsapp, not this browser; Chrome is only for logging in there and for security checks.
examples: root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|open github in chrome -> discover(path='mcp/chrome', enable=true); chrome_navigate_page(url='https://github.com') or chrome_new_page(url='https://github.com')
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|what is on the page -> chrome_take_snapshot()
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|click the sign-in button -> chrome_take_snapshot(); chrome_click(uid='…')

root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|attach report.pdf to the form -> chrome_take_snapshot(); chrome_click(uid='…' of the upload button); system|chrome [file dialog opened] -> chrome_choose_files(paths=['/home/bia/files/report.pdf'])
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|there is a captcha on the page -> discover(path='mcp/screen', enable=true); screen_shot(); screen_cursor_move_human(x=…, y=…); screen_click(x=…, y=…)
